title: The AD CS autoenrollment sc_partial row tests partial knowledge, and a test asserts the scenario answer-not-in-pack message
goal: The sc_partial row on AD CS certificate autoenrollment templates in kb/public/_retrieval/bench_scenarios.csv and bench_pool.csv is replaced by a question whose present part a kb line answers (its regex today matches the Intune PKCS connector template line while the kb has no autoenrollment fact, so the row tests absent knowledge); _tools/test_bench.py asserts scenario_problems' message for a row whose answer regex matches no line of its pack

run: import sys,csv;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import bench_pool as b;S=list(csv.DictReader(open(b.SCENARIO_FILE,encoding="utf-8",newline="")));P=b.read_csv(b.PUBLIC_FILE);bad=[r["question"] for r in S+P if r["kind"]=="sc_partial" and "autoenrollment" in r["question"].lower()];n=[sum(r["kind"]=="sc_partial" for r in L) for L in (S,P)];print(bad,n);sys.exit(1 if bad or n!=[6,6] else 0)
import sys;t=open("_tools/test_bench.py",encoding="utf-8").read();sys.exit(0 if "matches no line of the pack" in t else 1)
